repository_rule: A repository is official only when linked by the paper/project page or owned by the author organization with explicit paper attribution. Third-party reimplementations and same-name unrelated projects are excluded.
recheck_recipe: Clone each repository URL, fetch the audited commit, and inspect it in detached mode.
Use git ls-tree -r <commit> to enumerate committed code and artifacts; do not infer logs from ignored local files.
For official GitHub Releases or author-linked archives, preserve release/tag identity, byte size, entry count, and internal schema separately from the Git tree.
Search paper and project pages by exact title and author when no repository is linked; record no-official-repository rather than substituting a third-party implementation.
Never execute model/API inference while repeating this static audit.

sources.artifact_finding: Sixteen static result PNGs plus configs/notebooks; no raw per-case JSON/CSV debate logs.
No run logs or result/config package; public code temperature differs from the paper setting.

The code writes chats and summaries when run, but no generated conversation/result/log artifacts are committed. A case-insensitive exact-gold scan finds target strings in 21/302 initial and 31/302 follow-up presentations; the loader and prompt inject them without cleaning.
No data/results/logs/config. Public call paths and advanced-report usage do not faithfully implement several paper claims.

2,865 text case files: MedQA 1,273; PubMedQA 500; six MMLU subsets 1,089; LFQ 3. The public MedQA snapshot contains one damaged file and routes 993 initial-stop/280 debate, versus the paper's 1,019 unanimous/254 disagreement. Headline totals can be repaired, but the conditional mechanism census and ten-run result cannot be reproduced.

No committed output trajectories or results; placeholder configuration and mapping data only. Public defaults differ between mixed and same-vendor temperature, RareBench mixed hard-codes a Gemini supervisor, evaluator mappings differ, and provenance labels can be wrong.

Eleven static HTML visualizations, no W&B histories or run metrics. The runtime lacks the paper's premise/decomposition/credibility/tree graph; graph code is under test and the executed auditor/moderator remain free text.

Source and combination-sweep script only; no README, requirements, dataset, results, configs, or logs. Runtime averages N-by-N reviews including self; majority tie handling is lexicographic, and the executed judge prompt/parser differ from the paper rubric.

Four main JSONs contain 2,800 per-case config records; five per-specialist JSONs contain 3,200 specialist records. Verification changes temperature/seed together with rationale visibility. C3-to-C4 rescue/harm is 4/0, 8/3, 3/5, and 8/15. C2 stores final S_score but not I; C4 omits full mediator traces, and current saving code postdates the main artifacts.
Cross-referenced from the prior full code audit; no model calls or redundant re-clone were needed for the MAS synthesis.

Two fixed GPT-4o/DDxPlus patient logs and a two-case result/config package; no dynamic or paper-scale logs. OpenChoice can record a forced diagnosis then execute history, and full-profile few-shot retrieval is label-bearing.
Microsoft states that code and data will be released upon publication; no author/Microsoft official repository was found by the research date.
No author/Microsoft official repository was found. The-Swarm-Corporation repository declares itself a third-party paper implementation and was excluded.

Twenty-nine tracked files, no results/data/config/logs, and missing required app_config.py and experience_memory.py. MCTS score lacks visit exploration, simulations fabricate state/evidence, reward is self-referential, and the public commit is not experiment-reproducible.

Eight code/demo files only; no benchmark scripts, datasets, KB, configs, results, or logs. Round-one KB exposure, retrieval k, default tool use, and grading/memory lifecycle differ from the paper; this is a later demo, not the experiment implementation.

Official Drive archive: 2,005,920,088 compressed bytes, 22,150 entries, 3,434,734,626 bytes unpacked. Main logs: QA 13,847, lay summary 2,000, released EHR 600. case_history retains collaborative rounds; token usage is absent.
Task-4 official implementation and results repository; workflow completeness bundles tools, code execution, state, and additional calls.

Source 36 JSONL/3,600; audit 144/14,370 valid; single 24/2,395; extracted open-coding 35/677; audit-human 20/400; shared open-coding-human 33/330; invalid 6/27. Paper text says 360 shared open-coding cases, while release/supplement material yields 330.
